heading: Definitions
lead: For the purposes of this subchapter, “agency”, “employee”, and “position” have the meanings given them by section 5102.

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective on such date as the President shall determine, but not earlier than 90 days, and not later than 180 days, after Nov. 5, 1990, see section 529 [title III, § 305] of Pub. L. 101–509, set out as an Effective Date of 1990 Amendment note under section 5301 of this title.
